news.title: Man arrested after stray bullet hits boy in southeast Atlanta, police say
news.summary: A man is in custody after a stray bullet from a neighborhood dispute hit a young boy late Friday night in the Ormewood Park neighborhood, according to police.

news.title: Suspect arrested in connect to deadly shooting
news.summary: A suspect has been arrested in connection with a deadly shooting earlier this month, Clayton County PD announced Saturday.

news.title: Wanted man arrested in deadly Clayton County gas station shooting
news.summary: Authorities have arrested a homicide suspect wanted in connection with a deadly shooting at a Clayton County gas station earlier this month, police announced Saturday.

news.title: Man arrested 2 years after road rage shooting on GA 400
news.summary: A road rage incident on Georgia 400 left a driver shot in both arms. More than two years later, the man accused of opening fire has been arrested in New York City.

news.summary: Inique Hinton, 31 of Douglasville, is facing federal charges in this case.

news.summary: A Cobb County judge denied bond Friday for an 18-year-old man accused of dismembering a woman inside a Smyrna apartment in September.

news.title: Suspect in 2024 GA 400 road rage shooting arrested in New York City
news.summary: A suspect wanted in connection with a 2024 road rage shooting that left a driver wounded on Georgia 400 has been tracked down and arrested in New York City, authorities said.

news.title: 31-year-old man arrested in Molotov attack on Atlanta ICE building
